title: 4x2 AND-OR-INVERT (7453 - 7454)

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 5 (pin assignments and function tables)
TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 6 (gate and flip-flop data sheets)

pins.name: X
pins.text: expander node: connect to the X output of a 7460 expander; leave open if not used

pins.name: X'
pins.text: expander node: connect to the X-bar output of a 7460 expander; leave open if not used

functions.formula: Y = NOT ((A AND B) OR (C AND D) OR (E AND F) OR (G AND H) OR X)
functions.text: Y is low when any of the pairs AB, CD, EF, GH is all high, or an expander on X/X' has all its inputs high (X = output of a 7460).

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, expander pins open
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, expander pins open

electrical.notes: Designed for use with up to four 7460 expanders.

unknown: Propagation delay of the 7453 when driven through a 7460 expander: the table gives that row only for the '50.
notes: The manual title groups 7453 and 7454; this file describes the expandable 7453. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
